## Summary

What problem does this solve, and what changed? Link the related issue if any.

## Verification

List commands run and results. Separate automated/mock, emulator, physical-phone
and live-provider checks; explicitly state what was not tested.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and has regression tests where appropriate.
- [ ] Relevant tests, typecheck and lint pass.
- [ ] Documentation reflects behavior/configuration changes.
- [ ] No credentials, signing files, private data or unconsented recordings are included.
- [ ] Consent, explicit stop controls, source validation and gap reporting are preserved.
- [ ] UI changes were checked for large text, both themes and screen-reader labels, or limitations are noted.
